course_name_original: Who is the man? Contemporary controversy
course_name_en: Who is the man? Contemporary controversy

learning_outcomes.text: Knows the basic paradigms of analysis in social sciences and humanities.
Knows the relationships between social processes, structures, and institutions and their elements in contemporary society.
Can interpret texts from the field of social sciences and humanities and expand their knowledge of culture and society based on them.
Is aware of the importance of sociological analysis and humanistic reflection for understanding contemporary social, political, economic, and cultural processes.

syllabus_topics: Lost words: honor, shamelessness, integrity, decency
assessment_rules: Learning outcomes are verified by an essay. Students participate in classes, learning subsequent teaching content according to the course syllabus. Students should ask questions and clarify doubts on an ongoing basis. Audiovisual recording of the lecture requires the lecturer's consent.
